suites.title: Invariant B — locale 404 carries the full security header set

specs.title: GET /xx/contact → 404 with all nine headers and X-Request-Id
GET /Xx/contact → 404 (mixed case, still an unknown locale) with the full header set
a deep path under an invalid locale is 404 and still headered

suites.title: Invariant B — locale 301 carries the full security header set

specs.title: GET /FR/contact → 301 to /fr/contact with all nine headers and X-Request-Id
GET /EN/ → 301 to /en/ with all nine headers and X-Request-Id
the 301 preserves the query string while canonicalising the locale
the 301 emits a distinct X-Request-Id per response (correlation, not a constant)
an inbound valid X-Request-Id is propagated verbatim on the 301
a malformed X-Request-Id is replaced, not echoed, on the 301
a guest can walk the whole public site in FR without a single 4xx/5xx
